definitions.showcase_table: For each ascending band, RMSE=sqrt(mean_q((prediction-target)^2)), L1=mean_q(abs(prediction-target)), NRMSE=RMSE/(max_q(target)-min_q(target)); sum each quantity over the three bands. Same aggregation as historical one-/two-band showcase rows, using corrected stored q_hat grid and targets.
definitions.adopted_metric: For each sample, mean over three bands of per-band RMSE / sqrt(mean_q(target^2)); population primary is arithmetic mean over samples. Wave-number columns excluded.
definitions.quantile: Median and 95th percentile of per-sample adopted scores; NumPy quantile method=linear, checked against scores.json.
definitions.ambiguity: NRMSE alone does not identify range versus RMS normalization or band sum versus mean. The showcase table uses historical range-normalized band sums; population and generalization use adopted RMS-normalized band means. No zero-range fallback: this computation fails if any showcased band has zero range.

main_resources.training_timing_scope: committed updates incl. in-memory batch copies/transfers; one storage read per attempt recorded separately; interrupted unsaved work excluded
main_resources.generation_timing_scope: Sum of manifest chunk generation_write_hash_seconds; includes curve generation, writing and hashing. Training-only and all-split totals are separate. Does not measure total pipeline wall time or all setup/label generation.

presentation_choices.showcase: 2x2 panels, ascending bands colored blue/green/red, solid targets and black dashed designs, independent panel y limits, same style as the one- and two-band showcase figures; q_hat is the normalized wave number.
presentation_choices.generalization: Two population means on shared M5 targets, 10000 examples each; linear zero-based axis; no own-count series or uncertainty band. One fit per interaction count.
presentation_choices.population_table: Rows mean, median, 95th percentile, count and invalid designs; columns stratified, uniform and boundary.
